reasons: The locked preferred level is fully satisfied: New York governing law plus exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, as one corresponding pair.
Fallback elements are not met, which is expected and immaterial where the preferred bargain is achieved; the levels are not mixed.

Minimality holds: the document had no governing law or venue clause at all, and a single concise new 27.3 was inserted with no edits to the existing escalation language in 27.1 or the law-characterisation language in 27.2.

Minor tension worth noting (not a defect in the redline): 27.1 still calls the Management Committee procedure the "sole and exclusive remedy," so the new exclusive-jurisdiction sentence should ideally be made expressly subject to or without prejudice to 27.1; as drafted the court-venue provision remains operative and the untouched clauses remain effective, and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
